item.title: Self-Hosted Certificate Transparency Log Server Infrastructure: Trillian and CT Log Deployment Guide (2026)
item.description: Certificate Transparency (CT) is an open framework for monitoring and auditing TLS certificate issuance. Every major browser requires certificates to be logged in publicly auditable CT logs before they are trusted. This public logging system creates a tamper-evident record of every certificate issued by participating certificate authorities, enabling domain owners and security researchers to detect misissued or fraudulent certificates in real time.
